jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. The man from the reference stands in a dark cozy living room, serious strong calm look into the camera, warm amber rim light on one side and a soft glow of light behind him, like light breaking through darkness. He is in the LOWER half of the frame, centred, from the waist up, face fully visible and NOT covered by text. Typography centred between 14% and 42% of the image height: smaller white uppercase «ЛЮДИ, КОТОРЫХ» on one line, then much larger bold warm amber-gold uppercase «НЕВОЗМОЖНО СЛОМАТЬ» on two lines under it. No other text.
